src: Patients received six cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy with capecitabine and oxaliplatin every 3 weeks.

src: Concurrent chemoradiotherapy with weekly cisplatin was given to a total dose of 70 Gy in 35 fractions.
The objective response rate was 42% and the disease control rate was 78% according to RECIST 1.1.

src: Patients with an ECOG performance status of 0-1 were eligible for first-line pembrolizumab.
Neoadjuvant chemotherapy was followed by surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy.
Stereotactic body radiotherapy delivered 50 Gy in 5 fractions to the residual liver lesion.

src: The case was discussed at the multidisciplinary tumor board, and palliative care was recommended.

At a median follow-up of 24 months, the hazard ratio for death was 0.68 (95% CI 0.52-0.89).

src: Overall survival did not differ between the two arms of this randomized phase III trial.
Induction chemotherapy was given to patients with advanced-stage nasopharyngeal carcinoma before concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
Palliative surgery was considered only when the tumour was unresectable.
